features.text: CreateSignatures: Creates new signatures in the document and saves resultant document into 'Output' folder (POST /signature/create)
SearchSignatures: Searches for signatures applied to the document (POST /signature/search)
VerifySignatures: Verifies whether document contains signatures that meet the specified criteria (POST /signature/verify)
UpdateSignatures: Updates signatures in the document (POST /signature/update)
DeleteSignatures: Deletes signatures in the document (POST /signature/delete)
GetSupportedFileFormats: Retrieves supported file formats list (GET /signature/formats)
GetInfo: Retrieves basic document info - path, extension, formats, size etc (POST /signature/info)
